coverage.ccm: reset identity; 2 staged/committed signed Q6.10 matrices; cross-channel terms, positive/negative half-LSB cases, signed offsets, lower/upper clipping
coverage.gamma: RGB888 bypass then three independently loaded channel LUTs; every address 0..255 exercised in every channel; no interpolation tested/claimed
coverage.stream: ready/valid alignment, SOF/EOL propagation, CE pause, output stability during CE pause and backpressure

limits.ccm: 8-bit RGB input/output, signed 16-bit Q6.10 coefficients, signed 16-bit integer biases, local +512/>>>10 rounding and uint8 saturation; not exhaustive over all coefficient triples
limits.gamma: 8-bit input/output, 256 addresses per channel, arbitrary loaded tables; does not verify a gamma curve generator or LUT memory inference
